oral_examination.oral_examination: 18 1/2 crowns have erupted, and the gums are not red or swollen.

source_handle: 18. Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine was used to divide the gingiva, increase the gap, loosen the gums, remove them with forceps, and apply compression to stop bleeding.
